title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode2 STANDOUT

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_leoneed_op1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, I was just...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also... That sound I'm hearing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Is this...?)
We're almost up.
Are you ready, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Did you fall asleep while standing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I don't know how to do that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just... Thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Really? Right before a show?
You must be feeling pretty relaxed.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
<The wait is over, everyone!
Next up on the Jam Fest Rookie Stage is...!>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
<The hottest band right now! STANDOUT!
They've been all the rage with their rare dual-bassist setup!>

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, we're off to a good start.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Nice. Even though this venue's huge, she's playing really well.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (And so are the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: (My job is to be the foundation of their sound.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My job is to garnish the melody by giving it some extra flair.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And then...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No matter how saturated the instrumentals get, her voice remains crystal clear.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is us...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're STANDOUT!!)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great show yesterday!
I saw the stream of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You were so unbelievably cool!
Especially the part in the interlude when you made your right hand go pop-pop-pop-pop!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Again, it's called slap.
Also, that was my time to shine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, slap!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know bassists could grab everybody's attention like that! I was watching by myself, but I got super excited!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, our band does have two bassists. I'm able to play so freely because of Mio's support.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that Mio person was also really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I recall, she wasn't planning on going pro originally. You were supposed to replace her as STANDOUT's new bassist, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Wait, why do you know that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I read it online in an interview article!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so beautiful how she decided to go pro with her friend so they can keep making music together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our band takes top priority now, so we have to put all the effort we can into our music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now that I'm also a pro...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the article I read also talked about why you guys decided to go with two bassists!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you talking about how “things would be more fun”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I started cracking up because of how simple that response was!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Iori also surprised me when she suggested it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She generally likes to keep her cool and think things through, but she can be pretty wild sometimes. She'll just go with her gut in those moments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?! I actually think that's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize that interview was already out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've honestly lost track of which interviews are gonna be released when because we've done so many.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That means you guys are super popular!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. The more famous you get, Shiho, the more I get to brag about how we used to be in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's fine, but won't you disappoint everyone when they find out that you're talking about us back in elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No way! Plus, I get to brag about how we've been friends since we were little!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More importantly, since you saw Jam Fest, that means you know about our homecoming show, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I really wanna go see it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's probably gonna be impossible to get tickets! I don't have much luck with this sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About that. Our manager's been asking us about the section for invited guests.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Want me to see if I can reserve a seat for y—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I really, really, really, really, really wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't make it to Jam Fest, but I absolutely positively wanna cheer you guys on at your next show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That just leaves the date.
I hope it doesn't conflict with your club's schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not a problem! The show's at night, so even if we have practice that day, I can just go after we've wrapped up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're gonna come after practice? Just how much stamina do you have?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
A ton, because I've been running every day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So much so that I'm faster than Hona now♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. That's right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's chock-full of energy now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When we were in elementary school, she had to take a lot of time off. But ever since she joined her club in junior high, her stamina's skyrocketed.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, Saki.
I need to go talk to Ichika for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, no fair!
I wanna talk to her too, Shiho!
